fields.statement: Verifier at eeb31b73 (attempt 2). go test -trimpath -count=1 -v ./internal/tui/inboxapp/: all 34 tests pass, including TestBlockerShowsEveryWordWrapped (300+ char blocker, every word present once opened at width 70, no line wider than 70, 'Blocks: Web UI'), TestGateRowShowsQuestionsAndWhatTheyBlock (row shows the first question's restatement; opened view shows each question with 'Blocks: Pick storage' and 'Blocks: Scale out'), TestScrubKeepsWordsAndDropsOnlyWholeIDs (blocker on handle 'store' keeps 'hold the store when' in the question and 'Blocks: Kept store reachable'), TestNoSurfaceShowsAnIDOrHandle (every kind's row, form, detail, send-back and resolve form shows no handle, ULID or short ID), TestOverlapRowNamesBothChangeSetsAndTarget. go test ./internal/api -run 'Inbox|Overlap' ok; go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(describe-golden|inbox.*)$' ok. Read the diff: scrub now replaces only whole id-like tokens (digit, -, _ or .), overlap rows name the other change set and target statement, target_title added to InboxItem and the describe golden. A whole ./internal/api run hit the 600s go test timeout at load average ~10 (machine contention); the inbox-scoped subset passes in 15s.
